title: Recursive driver/engine delegation contract on the core capability bus
goal: Mandate 73 recursion adapter, first slice: a component can be a driver and an engine at once, nested through capability dispatch, with preserved identity/provenance, no permission amplification, parent-reserved budgets, inherited deadlines, depth and fan-out bounds, cycle refusal, cancellation propagation and failure propagation; continue the nesting across the socket with an envelope on os_capabilities and the CLI.
capabilities: susi_core::delegation::DelegationScope (delegate, charge, cancel, check, path, envelope, from_envelope)
os_capabilities MCP tool `delegation` argument; susi os capabilities invoke --delegation
acceptance: cargo test --offline --locked -p susi-core --lib -- delegation capability_bus registry
cargo clippy --offline --locked -p susi-core -p susi-gmcp -p susi-cli-defs --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo test --offline --locked -p susi --test socket_parity --test lean_core_ceilings --test architecture_tests
scripts/gmcp-record-evidence.sh then --mastery (GMCP vector evidence re-bound to the changed susi-gmcp source)
host: Claude Code cloud session, Linux x86_64, 4 vCPU, 15 GiB RAM, Rust 1.99.0 (pinned), Git 2.43.0

results.susi_core_lib: 481/481 passed (15 new: 14 in src/tests/delegation.rs, 1 registry envelope test); 37 focused (delegation|capability_bus|registry) passed
results.clippy: clean with -D warnings: susi-core, susi-gmcp, susi-cli-defs (--all-targets) and the susi binary
results.lean_core: susi-gmcp stays at its 25,900-line ceiling: the 2-line typed `delegation` schema field is offset by inlining two single-use imports in os_capabilities; parsing and nesting live in susi-core (no pillar ceiling); the GMCP test lives in crates/susi-gmcp/tests (outside counted src)
results.wire_change: CapabilityReceipt gains optional `delegation_path` (skipped when empty; older receipts still deserialize); CapabilityError gains `Delegation`; dispatch now refuses an empty or control-character subject/permission as InvalidIdentity

limitations: Envelopes are unsigned: they bound cooperating components, not an adversary; the host MAC policy remains the socket authority.
Cancellation does not cross an envelope; the remaining deadline does. Budget accounting is per process.
Only capability dispatch opens scopes; harness missions, GEMI worker delegation and GAWD swarm hand-offs are not wired yet.
A running handler is not pre-empted at its deadline; the existing elapsed-time check still applies.
Not run on native Windows x86_64 in this session.
